story.soThat: I can organize code efficiently and follow best practices

subtasks.subtask: Verify directory structure matches architecture requirements
Add Docker exclusions (`.dockerignore` already handled separately)
Exclude `docs/` directory (documentation not needed in containers)
Exclude `*.md` files (markdown files not needed in containers)
Exclude `.env` file (environment variables passed via Docker Compose)
Create `backend/requirements.txt` placeholder (empty or with basic structure comment)
Create `mcp_server/requirements.txt` placeholder (empty or with basic structure comment)
Create `telegram_bot/requirements.txt` placeholder (empty or with basic structure comment)
Verify virtual environment directories are excluded in `.gitignore`
Document Python version requirement (3.12+) in README
Add project overview (Annie - Personal AI Companion)
Add setup instructions (prerequisites: Docker, Docker Compose)
Add quick start guide (reference to `run_docker.sh` - will be created in Story 1.5)
Add links to key documentation (PRD, Architecture Plan)
Add project status badge or note (V1.0 MVP in development)

criterion.description: Given a fresh repository, when I check the directory structure, then it includes `backend/`, `mcp_server/`, `telegram_bot/`, `scripts/`, `docs/` directories
Given the project structure, when I check the repository, then `.gitignore` exists with appropriate exclusions (Python, Docker, IDE files, `.env`, `__pycache__`, `*.pyc`)
Given the project structure, when I check the repository, then `.dockerignore` exists with appropriate exclusions (`.git`, `docs`, `*.md`, `.env`)
Given the repository, when I check Python structure, then virtual environment directories are excluded and `requirements.txt` structure is defined
Given the repository, when I check documentation, then initial `README.md` exists with project overview and setup instructions

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Annie is a personal AI companion chatbot designed to help friends and relatives make better decisions. Must run in Docker containers and support MCP protocol standards.

doc.title: Architecture Plan
doc.snippet: Defines service architecture with Backend API (FastAPI), MCP Server (Python MCP SDK), Telegram Bot (python-telegram-bot), and Redis. Services communicate via Docker network.

doc.title: Epic 1 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Defines project structure requirements: backend/, mcp_server/, telegram_bot/, scripts/, docs/ directories. Specifies .gitignore and .dockerignore requirements for security and build optimization.

doc.title: Epic and Story Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story 1.1 establishes foundational project structure with directory organization, .gitignore, .dockerignore, Python structure, and README.md. Maps to Tasks 1.1 (partial).

doc.title: V1.0 Detailed Task Breakdown
doc.section: Task 1.1: Project Structure Setup Task 1.1 specifies creating directory structure (backend/, mcp_server/, telegram_bot/, scripts/, docs/), initializing git repository, creating .gitignore and .dockerignore files, and creating initial README.md.

ecosystem.name: python
ecosystem.note: Required for all Python services (Backend, MCP Server, Telegram Bot). Will be specified in Dockerfiles.

ecosystem.note: Required for containerization. Will be validated by run_docker.sh script.

constraint.description: .env file must be excluded from both .gitignore and .dockerignore to prevent sensitive data exposure
Use underscore for mcp_server directory (not kebab-case) for Python module compatibility
Directory structure must align with Architecture Plan service architecture (backend/, mcp_server/, telegram_bot/)
README.md must reference PRD and Architecture Plan, include setup instructions and directory structure explanation

tests.standards: No automated tests required for this story. Manual verification: Check directory structure exists, verify .gitignore and .dockerignore files work correctly by creating test files matching ignore patterns and confirming they're excluded from git and Docker builds.

test.description: Verify all required directories exist: backend/, mcp_server/, telegram_bot/, scripts/, docs/
Create test files matching .gitignore patterns (__pycache__/, *.pyc, .env, venv/) and verify they're excluded from git
Create test files matching .dockerignore patterns (.git/, docs/, *.md) and verify they're excluded from Docker build context
Verify requirements.txt files exist in backend/, mcp_server/, telegram_bot/ directories
Verify README.md exists with project overview, setup instructions, and directory structure explanation
